name: Sheridan Hotel
description: Alongside the Bronx River, this simple 4-story hotel is a 7-minute walk from Whitlock Av subway stop, 2 miles from Bronx Zoo and 3 miles from Yankee Stadium. Unfussy rooms all have pillow-top mattresses, free Wi-Fi, and flat-screen TVs with premium channels, as well as minifridges, microwaves and coffeemakers. Free perks consist of cooked breakfast and parking. There's a fitness room and a business center.

name: 7 Days Hotel
description: Located in a commercial area, this down-to-earth budget hotel is 7 miles from the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum and 4 miles from the Bronx Museum of the Arts. John F. Kennedy International Airport is 15 miles away. Functional rooms provide air conditioning, Wi-Fi and smart TVs, plus en suite bathrooms. Some accommodate up to 4 guests. Parking is available.

name: Wingate by Wyndham Bronx/Haven Park
description: Set a 2-minute walk from a subway station, this polished hotel is a mile from baseball matches at Yankee Stadium, 2 miles from Central Park and 3 miles from the Metropolitan Museum of Art. Hip rooms feature Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, as well as tea and coffeemaking facilities. Some have bunk beds. Room service is available. A restaurant features funky Pop Art-style decor. There's also a bar, a fitness room and a breakfast buffet, plus valet parking.

name: Hotel 365 Bronx
description: Set in the South Bronx neighborhood, this straightforward budget hotel is a mile from the Yankee Stadium and 7 miles from the Empire State Building. 138 Street - Grand Concourse subway station is a 3-minute walk away. The unpretentious, simply furnished rooms with neutral colors feature Wi-Fi and 65-inch TVs, as well as minifridges. Parking is available.

name: Opera House Hotel
description: A converted 1913 opera house is the setting for this boutique hotel in the South Bronx, 2 blocks from the nearest subway station and 1.5 miles from Yankee Stadium. The warm, refined rooms feature plush beds with upholstered leather headboards, as well as marble bathrooms and flat-screen TVs. Rooms also come with minifridges and microwaves; WiFi is available for a fee. Free perks include 24-hour coffee and tea in the lobby, plus a continental breakfast served each day on the hotel's mezzanine level and access to an 18,000-sq-ft fitness center. Parking is available on a first-come, first served basis.

name: Umbrella Hotel Bronx
description: A 5-minute walk from the closest subway station, this casual hotel is 1 mile from baseball games at Yankee Stadium and 3 miles from the Bronx Zoo. Streamlined rooms provide free Wi-Fi, flat-screens and desks, as well as minifridges and coffeemakers; some feature city views. Complimentary amenities include parking and a continental breakfast buffet. Meeting space is available.

name: Super 8 by Wyndham Bronx Near Stadium
Comfort Inn & Suites
description: A 4-minute walk from 3rd Avenue-138 Street subway station, this informal hotel in an industrial area is 2 miles from Central Park and 5 miles from the Bronx Zoo. The bright, relaxed rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers, along with minifridges and microwaves. Suites add separate living areas. A hot breakfast buffet is complimentary. Amenities include a fitness room and a hip living room-style lobby. Limited parking is available for a surcharge.

name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Bronx - Zoo Area by IHG
Highbridge Hotel
description: Set on a leafy street in the Bronx, this unpretentious hotel in is 3 minutes’ walk from a subway station, 10 minutes’ walk from Yankee Stadium and 4 miles from New York Botanical Garden. The laid-back rooms provide Wi-Fi, TVs and minifridges. Some add safes. Suites feature sitting areas. There’s a rooftop terrace with picnic tables. A breakfast buffet is served in a down-to-earth dining area adjacent to the lobby. Parking is also available.

name: Residence Inn by Marriott New York The Bronx at Metro Center Atrium
description: This contemporary hotel is 3 miles from the Bronx Zoo and the New York Botanical Garden. It's 10.4 miles from Central Park. Stylish, elegant suites feature kitchens, and separate living areas with pull-out sofas, as well as free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and desks. Complimentary perks include a breakfast buffet and parking. There's a trendy lobby with a modern fireplace, plus a fitness center, and a patio featuring a fire pit.

name: Super 8 by Wyndham Bronx
description: A 3-minute walk from Freeman St subway station, this unassuming budget hotel is also 2 miles from both the Bronx Zoo and Yankee Stadium. The warmly decorated rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers. Children age 17 and under stay at no extra cost with an adult. Complimentary perks consist of parking and a continental breakfast buffet.

name: Global Luxury Suites at The Arches
Best Western Plus City Line Hotel
description: Featuring a colorful facade, this unpretentious hotel is set off both Interstate 87 and Interstate 278. It's 11 minutes away on foot from Cypress Av subway station, 2 miles from Central Park and 3 miles from Yankee Stadium. The streamlined rooms provide Wi-Fi, smart TVs and minifridges. There's a fitness room. A breakfast buffet and limited parking are also available.

name: Days Inn by Wyndham Bronx Near Stadium
description: Set a 7-minute drive (or a 15-minute bus ride) from Yankee Stadium, this unpretentious 3-story hotel is 2.5 miles from the Bronx Zoo, a 6-minute walk from the Melrose Metro-North station and a 19-minute walk from the Prospect Avenue subway stop. The casual rooms and suites all include en suite bathrooms with showers and tubs, and have free WiFi, flat-screens, coffeemakers and desks with ergonomic chairs. Some suites also offer whirlpool tubs. Kids 17 and under stay free with a paying adult. Continental breakfast is complimentary, as is parking for cars, trucks and buses. There's also an exercise room and business center.

name: Ramada by Wyndham Bronx
description: Close to chain stores at the Bronx Terminal Market, this low-key hotel off a leafy street is a 10-minute walk from baseball games at Yankee Stadium, 7 minutes’ walk from a subway station and 6 miles from the Bronx Zoo. The down-to-earth rooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, in addition to minifridges and coffeemakers. Free breakfast is served in a simple dining room. Other amenities include a gym and a business center.

name: West Farms Hotel
description: This unfussy hotel is a 2-minute walk from the West Farms Square–East Tremont Avenue subway station, 8 minutes on foot from the Bronx Zoo and 3 miles from baseball games at Yankee Stadium. Warm rooms with a contemporary vibe offer complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemakers. Kids stay at no charge in a parent's room. Continental breakfast is included. There's also a business center. Parking is available.

name: Hotel Ninety Five Fordham / St. Barnabas Hospital
Pelham Garden Motel
description: Located near the intersection of I-95 and the Hutchinson River Parkway, low-rise motel named after its Pelham Gardens neighborhood is 1 mile from the Bay Plaza Shopping Center and 10 miles from Yankee Stadium. The quirky, air-conditioned rooms and suites, some featuring round canopy beds and/or Jacuzzi tubs adorned with columns and mirrored walls, offer free WiFi and flat-screen TVs with cable channels. Free amenities include on-site parking and taxi-calling service from the lobby. There are also several vending machines with snacks and beverages on the property.

name: Super 8 by Wyndham Bronx Near Botanical Garden
Jet Set Hotel
description: With functional rooms, this modern building lies a 15-minute walk from the Bronx Zoo and a 7-minute walk from a subway station with trains to the Upper West Side. Rooms have warm, contemporary decor, plus free WiFi, 42-inch, flat-screen TVs with premium channels, as well as minibars, coffee makers, microwaves and mini-fridges. Some have private balconies. There’s complimentary parking and laundry facilities.

name: Morris Guest House
description: Situated in brownstone building in a historic district of the Bronx, Morris Avenue, this laid-back guest house sits on a tree-lined residential street. It’s half a block away from the 36 bus, which serves the Bronx Zoo, 1.6 miles away, with its adjacent botanical gardens. The 14-minute subway into Manhattan is 2 blocks, from Tremont Avenue station; which also serves Fordham University, 2.4 miles away. Streamlined rooms with simple decor and wood floors feature shared bathrooms; most have air-conditioning. Wi-Fi in the public areas is free, while some guests have access to a communal kitchen.

name: Days Inn by Wyndham Bronx NYC
Rodeway Inn Bronx Zoo
description: Laid-back rooms in a straightforward hotel offering a gym, plus complimentary breakfast & Wi-Fi.

name: Howard Johnson Inn Yankee Stadium
description: Relaxed rooms featuring traditional decor, plus free indoor parking & continental breakfast.

name: Oasis Motel
description: Warm, down-to-earth rooms in a straightforward motel featuring complimentary Wi-Fi.

name: Deegan
description: Unassuming property offering simple rooms with a/c & cable TV, plus free parking.

name: Friendly Motor Inn
description: Budget-friendly motor option with rooms featuring TVs, microwaves, fridges & complimentary parking.

name: Ramada by Wyndham Bronx
description: Overlooking I-95, this functional hotel is 4 miles from Pelham Bay Park, 6 miles from Orchard Beach and 8 miles from the New York Botanical Garden. Unassuming rooms and suites offer complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges. Some have whirlpool tubs, coffeemakers and/or sitting areas. Children age 17 and under stay free in a parent's room. Freebies include breakfast and parking. Other amenities consist of a hot tub and a convenience shop.

name: Concorde Hotel New York
description: In a high-rise building 4 minutes' walk from the nearest subway stop, this refined hotel is a 10-minute walk from the Museum of Modern Art and 2 miles from the Empire State Building. The airy, upscale rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, as well as rainfall showers and city views. Suites add sitting areas or separate living rooms with sofabeds, in addition to Nespresso machines. Some suites offer furnished terraces. There's also a 2-bedroom penthouse suite with a kitchen. Amenities include a business center and a 24-hour gym.

name: Metro Motel
description: A 1-minute walk from 241 Street Station subway station, this modest, unassuming motel with a portico is also 7 km from the rain forest display at New York Botanical Garden and 12 km from the playgrounds and trails at Van Cortlandt Park. Cozy, straightforward rooms with wood fixtures feature TVs and en suite bathrooms. Upgraded rooms add whirlpool tubs and sitting areas. Free on-site parking is available.

name: The Carnegie Hotel
description: A 3-minute walk from Carnegie Hall, this sleek, music-themed hotel is also a minute's walk from a subway station and a mile from the Empire State Building. Chic rooms with striking murals come with free Wi-Fi, 40-inch flat-screen TVs and iPod docks, plus minifridges and designer toiletries. Room service is available. A breakfast buffet, regular evening socials and access to a nearby health club are complimentary. Valet parking is offered for a surcharge.

name: 42 Hotel
description: Set in a vibrant neighborhood, this chic hotel designed by architect Lucas Lee and interior designer Andres Escobar is a mile from both Domino Park along the East River, and Artists and Fleas Williamsburg market. It's a minute's walk from Hewes St subway station. Featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, the elegant rooms offer flat-screens, Wi-Fi and minifridges, as well as coffeemakers and lounge chairs. There's a sleek restaurant and wine bar. Other amenities include a cafe and event space, plus a lobby with moving water walls. Breakfast is available.

name: Park House Hotel
description: Set in a restored redbrick apartment building, this upscale hotel is in the predominantly Orthodox Jewish neighborhood of Borough Park, 2 blocks from the nearest subway stop. Traditionally furnished studios offer free WiFi, flat-screen TVs and kitchenettes; suites add sleek, minimalist decor, full-size fridges and living rooms with pull-out sofas. An airy, elegant 2-bedroom penthouse has 2 baths, plus a 19-foot glass dining/conference table. In-room Shabbos meals are available (fee). Free amenities include a lavish kosher breakfast buffet (served every day but Saturday) that features made-to-order omelets and fresh baked goods.

name: Henry Norman Hotel
description: In a former warehouse from the 19th century, this hip hotel in Greenpoint is a 15-minute walk from McCarren Park and a 10-minute walk from the Nassau Avenue subway station. Eclectic rooms with hardwood floors and local art offer coffeemakers and minifridges, plus 42-inch flat-screen TVs, iPod docks and free Wi-Fi. Some have terraces. Suites add expanded sitting areas, and some have kitchens, roof decks or extra bedrooms. Amenities include a fitness room, a sauna and a 24-hour business center, plus free local car service and laundry facilities. Minimum-stay rules may apply.

name: The Box House Hotel
description: In a converted factory across the street from the Pulaski Bridge, this polished hotel in an industrial area is a 9-minute walk from the Greenpoint Avenue subway station and 6 miles from the Empire State Building. Featuring hardwood floors and artwork commissioned by local artists, the bright rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemaking facilities, as well as balconies offering city views. Loft rooms and 1- to 2-bedroom apartments have kitchens, living rooms, and pull-out couches. Amenities include an industrial-chic restaurant with a wood bar and pendant lamps, in addition to a gym, a sauna and a steam room.

name: Franklin Guesthouse
description: Set among bars, restaurants and cafes, this upscale boutique hotel is 5 minutes' walk from the East River, 6 minutes' walk from a subway station and 3 miles from the Empire State Building. Featuring wood floors and contemporary artwork, the polished suites provide complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and iPhone docks, plus minifridges and coffeemakers. Upgraded suites add kitchenettes, living areas, terraces and/or marble bathrooms. Amenities include a restaurant/bar, a fitness room and a sauna. An area shuttle is available.

name: Pod Brooklyn Hotel
description: In a contemporary building on a bustling street, this streamlined hotel is a 5-minute walk from the nearest subway station and a 9-minute walk from the Music Hall of Williamsburg. Bright, pared-down rooms with colorful accents feature free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as iPod docks and safes. Some rooms have bunk beds. Walking tours of the city are complimentary. There’s a rooftop bar. Parking is extra.

name: The William Vale
description: Providing views of the Manhattan skyline, this striking, upscale hotel is 4 miles from both Barclays Center arena and the Brooklyn Academy of Music. Bright, contemporary rooms have furnished balconies with skyline views, and offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges. Suites provide separate living rooms, while upgraded suites add furnished decks with hot tubs. Room service is available. There's an upscale Southern Italian restaurant and a trendy rooftop bar. Other amenities include an elevated park space, and a 60-foot outdoor pool with a cafe. Parking and breakfast are available (fee).

name: The Penny Hotel Williamsburg
description: Close to bars and eateries in the dynamic Williamsburg neighborhood, this trendy hotel is 6 miles from the Empire State Building and 7 miles from the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum. Bedford Avenue subway station is 5 minutes away by foot. Featuring contemporary artwork, the hip, relaxed rooms offer Wi-Fi and TVs, plus wet bars with minifridges, microwaves, and tea and coffeemaking equipment. Upgraded rooms add sitting areas, some with sofabeds. Suites feature separate living rooms and terraces. There's a chic rooftop bar/restaurant with a terrace and city views. Loaner bikes are available.

name: Ace Hotel Brooklyn
description: In the laid-back Boerum Hill neighborhood, this sleek hotel is a 2-minute walk from a subway station, 2 miles from the Brooklyn Botanic Garden, and 4 miles from the 9/11 Memorial & Museum. Featuring vintage furnishings and local artwork, the retro-inspired rooms provide flat-screen TVs, Wi-Fi and minifridges. Some add loaner guitars and vinyl record players. The 1-bedroom suites offer separate living rooms. Amenities include a colorful, hip restaurant and a 24-hour fitness center.

name: NU Hotel Brooklyn
description: A 4-minute drive from the Barclays Center, this modern boutique hotel is 0.7 miles from the Brooklyn Academy of Music arts venue and 4 blocks from a subway station. The airy, loft-style rooms have free Wi-Fi, desks, minibars, TVs and cork floors; suites add sitting areas, coffee tables and music systems. Some suites come with bunk beds, murals painted by local artists and lounging hammocks. A surcharge covers continental breakfast, loaner bikes, and use of the 24-hour gym and business center. There's also a trendy bar and lounge with cocktails and Spanish-style fare.

name: Holiday Inn Brooklyn Downtown by IHG
description: A 2-minute walk from the Hoyt-Schermerhorn Streets subway station, this contemporary hotel in Boerum Hill is a 10-minute walk from the Barclays Center arena and 2 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge. Sophisticated rooms with modern wood accents feature complimentary Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as work desks and minifridges. Kids 18 and younger stay free. There's a restaurant and a lounge bar, as well as an indoor pool, a fitness center and a guest laundry.

name: EVEN Hotel Brooklyn by IHG
description: This contemporary, wellness-oriented hotel with a living green wall is 2 blocks from the nearest subway, a 9-minute walk from sports and concerts at the Barclays Center, and a 25-minute subway ride from Manhattan. Tranquil rooms with modern decor feature mood lighting, eucalyptus linens, and exercise equipment such as yoga mats and resistance bands. All have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and work desks, as well as minifridges and coffeemakers. Amenities include a health food market and a bar with a serene lounge, as well as an interior courtyard. Parking is available (surcharge).

name: Hilton Brooklyn New York
description: Situated 6 blocks from the Barclays Center, this modern hotel is a 4-minute walk from the nearest subway station and a mile from the Brooklyn Bridge. Understated rooms feature free Wi-Fi, 49-inch flat-screen TVs, and desks with ergonomic chairs, plus coffeemakers and minibars. Suites add separate living rooms. Upgraded quarters also include access to a private lounge serving free breakfast and evening snacks. Room service is available. A sleek cafe/bar serves breakfast and dinner. There's also a fitness room, a business center and a 24-hour convenience store.

name: The Baltic Hotel
description: Set a 10-minute walk from a subway station, this relaxed hotel is 4 miles from both the One World Trade Center and ferries for the Statue of Liberty National Monument. It's 2 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge. Chic rooms have Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as street or city views. Upgraded rooms offer terraces. Studios feature sitting areas with pull-out couches.

name: The Tillary Hotel Brooklyn
description: Within a 10-minute walk of 3 subway stations, this sophisticate hotel is a mile from the Brooklyn Bridge, and 4 miles from activities on the High Line. The stylish, polished rooms offer free Wi-Fi, smart TVs, desks and minibars, plus designer toiletries and Italian linens. Upgraded rooms add tea and coffeemaking facilities; suites also feature separate living rooms with pull-out sofas. Amenities include a trendy cafe, a modern lobby lounge and a beer garden, as well as a fitness room and a furnished terrace. There's also a business center and a hip ballroom. Parking is available for a fee.

name: Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites New York Brooklyn
description: This straightforward hotel is 6 minutes' walk from Union Street subway station and 1 mile from Downtown Brooklyn. The Brooklyn Museum is 2 miles away. Bright rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, desks and coffeemakers. Upgraded rooms add minifridges, microwaves, and sitting areas with pull-out sofas. Some offer city views. Freebies include hot breakfast, plus coffee in the atrium-style lobby. There are also rooftop gardens and a picnic/BBQ area. Other amenities include a fitness center and paid parking.

name: New York Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge
description: A 2-minute walk from the Jay Street-MetroTech subway station, this upscale hotel is 8 minutes' walk from the Brooklyn Bridge and 2 miles from the One World Trade Center observation deck. Sleek rooms have flat-­screen TVs, Wi-Fi (fee) and desks, plus minifridges and coffeemakers; some add pull-out sofas and/or or city views. Suites offer living areas; some include balconies and/or kitchenettes. Club quarters provide access to a lounge with free breakfast and snacks. There's a relaxed American restaurant, a bar and a snack shop, as well as an indoor pool, a spa and a fitness center. Other amenities include 26 meeting rooms and a business center.

name: Union Hotel Brooklyn
description: Set 2 miles from the Brooklyn Botanic Garden, this straightforward hotel in a redbrick building is a 4-minute walk from Union St subway station and 4 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge. The casual, simply furnished rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers, plus minifridges and desks. Some include sofabeds. Amenities include a business center and a meeting room, as well as a dining area.

name: Aloft New York Brooklyn
description: A 2-minute walk from the Hoyt Street subway station, this chic hotel is 2 miles from the Brooklyn Museum. Trendy rooms have 42-inch flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi and desks with ergonomic chairs. They also include coffeemakers and minifridges, plus bathrooms featuring walk-in showers. Kids are welcomed with air mattresses, bedding and goodie bags. Dogs receive beds, treats and toys (fee). A retro lobby lounge offers check-in kiosks, a fireplace and a billiards table. There's a hip bar with mood music, and an upscale rooftop bar, plus an indoor pool, a 24/7 cafe and an all-day fitness room. A business center and 2 meeting rooms are available.

name: Sheraton Brooklyn New York Hotel
description: A 2-minute walk from the Hoyt Street subway station, this polished hotel is also 2 miles from the Brooklyn Museum, and 15 minutes' walk from NBA games and concerts at the Barclays Center. Modern rooms have 42-inch flat-screen TVs, coffeemakers and Wi-Fi (fee), plus work areas with desks and ergonomic chairs. Suites adds separate living areas, while club rooms provide access to a lounge offering complimentary continental breakfast, all-day snacks and evening appetizers. Amenities include a Mexican-American restaurant and a rooftop bar, plus an indoor pool and a 24/7 fitness center. There’s also a business center and 4,300 sq ft of meeting space.

name: Hotel Le Bleu
description: A 6-minute drive from the Brooklyn Museum and Botanical Gardens, this chic hotel is 3 blocks from a subway station and 3 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge. Modern rooms have free Wi-Fi and 42-inch flat-screen TVs with free movies, plus iPod docks and BOSE surround sound systems. They also include minifridges, coffeemakers, and stylish bathrooms with glass-enclosed showers and rainfall showerheads. Some rooms have balconies with city views across the river. Complimentary perks include breakfast, snacks and the use of the 24-hour business center.

name: Hampton Inn Brooklyn/Downtown
description: This modern hotel is 3 miles from both the Brooklyn Bridge and the historic Brooklyn Museum. All rooms include free Wi-Fi and custom-designed beds, plus work desks, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers. Some add minifridges. Suites add balconies with Manhattan-skyline views. Hot breakfast (daily) and weekday to-go breakfast are complimentary. There's a 24-hour fitness center, a bar and a 24-hour pantry store. Additional amenities include a business center and paid parking, plus a cozy lobby with a fireplace.

name: TownePlace Suites by Marriott New York Brooklyn
description: Set a minute's walk from both a subway station and a busy main street, this polished all-suite hotel is 3 miles from Brooklyn Bridge, 8 miles from the Empire State Building and 11 miles from the Metropolitan Museum of Art. Elegant suites have Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and kitchenettes. Upgraded suites feature pull-out sofas. The 1-bedroom suites provide separate living rooms. Amenities consist of a 24-hour gym and a coin-operated laundry. A breakfast buffet and parking are available.

name: The Lodge Red Hook
description: In a commercial area off I-478, this down-to-earth hotel is a mile from The Bell House concert venue and 2 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge. Straightforward rooms with wooden floors offer flat-screen TVs, coffeemakers and Wi-Fi. Upgraded rooms add city views. There's a laid-back sitting area in the lobby. Parking and continental breakfast are available.

name: 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge
description: In Brooklyn Bridge Park along the East River, this trendy hotel is a 12-minute walk from the nearest subway station and 9 miles from the Statue of Liberty. Industrial-chic rooms feature free Wi-Fi, smart TVs, Nespresso machines and yoga mats; most offer river, park or Statue of Liberty views. Suites have living areas and sofabeds; some add separate lounges. An upgraded 3-bedroom apartment features a dining area, a minibar, loaner bikes and a soaking tub. Room service is available 24/7. Amenities include a hip restaurant and a seasonal rooftop bar offering city views. There's also a screening room and a gym.

name: The Brooklyn Hotel
description: Set in a redbrick building, this trendy boutique hotel is a 4-minute walk from Nostrand Avenue subway station, a mile from the Brooklyn Museum and 4 miles from the iconic Brooklyn Bridge. The hip rooms feature exposed-brick walls, reclaimed-wood details and black-and-white wall art. All come with free Wi-Fi, smart TVs and laptop safes, as well as microwaves, minifridges and Nespresso machines. Suites add separate sitting areas with pull-out sofas. Freebies include coffee in the lobby, and continental breakfast served in an airy, industrial-chic dining room. There's also an exercise room and a convenience store.

name: Aura Hotel Brooklyn
description: Set 8 miles from the Empire State Building, this modern, upscale hotel is 2.7 miles from the Brooklyn Museum and 10 miles from the Statue of Liberty. Stylish rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and kitchenettes with microwaves, minifridges and coffeemakers, as well as desks. Suites add dining areas and parlors. Perks include free continental breakfast, a private garden, a relaxed lounge, laundry service and parking (surcharge). There's also event space.

name: Wyndham Garden Brooklyn Sunset Park
description: A 5-minute walk from a subway station, this trendy hotel with a distinctive geometric facade is 12 miles from the Statue of Liberty and 14 miles from LaGuardia Airport. Featuring street views and funky curved leather headboards, the bright, snug rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, as well as coffeemakers, microwaves and marble bathrooms. Upgraded rooms add views of the Manhattan skyline. There's a laid-back bar offering light fare and happy hours; continental breakfast is available for a fee. Pets are welcome, and a 24-hour airport shuttle and parking are offered, all for a surcharge.

name: Imperial Stay B&B
street_address: Entrance Between Allan’s Bakery & PAB Pharmacy, 1115 Nostrand Ave

name: Wythe Hotel
description: Housed in a historic, refurbished factory on the Brooklyn waterfront, this boutique hotel is a 5-minute walk from the seasonal Brooklyn Flea and 0.4 miles from the nearest subway station. Industrial-chic rooms have free Wi-Fi, custom-made furniture, heated cement floors and surround sound systems, as well as flat-screens TVs, minibars, high ceilings and unique commissioned artwork. Some rooms have exposed brick walls and arched windows with skyline views. Perks include a screening room, free access to a nearby gym, live entertainment (surcharge), a trendy rooftop bar and a French-inspired restaurant.

name: The Hoxton, Williamsburg
description: Situated on the grounds of a former factory in the hip Williamsburg neighborhood, this chic hotel is block from East River State Park, a 6-minute walk from the Bedford Av subway stop and 5 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge. Stylish, industrial-chic rooms with brass and concrete details include free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, work desks and en suite bathrooms. There are 3 bars and restaurants including 1 with private dining, and another that has a rooftop terrace offering panoramic city views.

name: Moxy Brooklyn Williamsburg
description: Set in an area with bars and restaurants, this choice hotel is 8 minutes away on foot from Domino Park along the East River, a 10-minute walk from the Marcy Ave subway station and 4 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge. Featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, stylish rooms come with Wi-Fi, safes and smart TVs, as well as Bluetooth speakers. Upgraded rooms add city views. Family rooms have bunk beds. Amenities include a chic cocktail bar/cafe, a Mediterranean restaurant, and a retro-style nightclub with DJ sets, plus a hip rooftop bar featuring a terrace and Manhattan skyline views. There's a 24-hour gym.

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham Brooklyn Downtown
description: Located 4 blocks from the 4th Avenue Subway station, this casual hotel is also 1 mile from Prospect Park and 4.1 miles from downtown Manhattan. All the colorful rooms include pillow-top mattresses, free WiFi and flat-screen TVs with HD channels, plus coffeemakers. Kids 18 and under stay free with a parent or grandparent. Continental breakfast is complimentary, and limited parking is available for a fee. Amenities also include a business center and guest laundry facilities.

name: Hotel Indigo Williamsburg - Brooklyn by IHG
description: In the trendy Williamsburg neighborhood, this sleek hotel in a modern building is a 3-minute walk from Metropolitan subway station and 4 minutes by foot from the offbeat City Reliquary Museum. It's 5 miles from the iconic Empire State Building. Airy, streamlined rooms and suites provide complimentary Wi-Fi and flat-screens, along with minifridges and coffeemakers. A seasonal outdoor pool features a sundeck and a poolside bar/eatery. There's also a restaurant, meeting space and a 24-hour gym. Breakfast and parking are available for a fee.

name: The L Hotel
description: A 4-minute walk from 36 Street subway station, this modern hotel is a 7-minute walk from eateries and art galleries at Industry City, and 3 miles from Prospect Park. Relaxed rooms feature free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as minifridges and Keurig coffeemakers. Upgraded rooms add city views. Free continental breakfast is served in a low-key dining room. Parking and meeting space are available.

name: NY Moore Hostel
description: In East Williamsburg, this unpretentious hostel is a 7-minute walk from the Morgan Ave L-train subway station, and 1.8 miles from Bedford Avenue's trendy bars and restaurants. High ceilings and hardwood floors style minimalist rooms offering a mix of eclectic furnishings. They all have free Wi-Fi and private bathrooms. Dorm rooms are women only or mixed genders. Private rooms are available. There's a fully equipped guest kitchen. Complimentary amenities include tea and coffee, parking and computer usage in the business center.

name: Arlo Williamsburg
description: Situated in a hip commercial area with bars and restaurants, this upmarket hotel in a stately redbrick building is a 7-minute walk from the nearest subway station, and 4 miles from the Empire State Building. Featuring custom furnishings, floor-to-ceiling windows and oak floors, the polished rooms provide free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and designer toiletries; some have balconies with views of Brooklyn and/or Manhattan. Suites add sitting areas. Loaner bikes and an area tuk-tuk shuttle are complimentary. Other amenities include 3 bars, a trendy restaurant and a seasonal rooftop pool, plus a seasonal pop-up restaurant and occasional live music.

name: Akwaaba Mansion
description: Set in a 19th century mansion in Stuyvesant Heights and filled with antiques, this ornate B&B is a 7-minute walk from a subway station and a 16-minute ride to Manhattan. Most of the 4 stately guest rooms include a 2-person Jacuzzi, and all iPod docks. Other amenities include fireplaces, chandeliers and/or floor-to-ceiling windows. Breakfast is included, and afternoon tea is also offered. Public spaces include a library, a TV and game room, a sun room and a shaded courtyard. Wi-Fi and street parking are available.

name: Comfort Inn Prospect Park-Brooklyn
description: Off Interstate 278, this relaxed hotel is a 5-minute walk from a subway station, a mile from Prospect Park and 2 miles from Brooklyn Museum's art exhibits. The warm rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minifridges, and tea and coffeemakers. A complimentary hot breakfast buffet is served in a casual dining area. There's also a 24-hour fitness room. Valet parking is available (surcharge).

name: Liberty View Brooklyn Hotel
description: Across from a police station, this laid-back hotel is a 4-minute walk from the nearest subway stop, 7 minutes’ walk from The Green-Wood Cemetery, and 5 miles from Battery Park for ferries to the Statue of Liberty on Liberty Island. Streamlined rooms offer flat-screen TVs, coffeemakers and minifridges. Some upgraded rooms add views of the Statue of Liberty. Breakfast is served in a modern dining area. Other amenities include a gym, a business center and a meeting room. Wi-Fi is available, as is parking.

name: Coda Williamsburg
description: Across from a park and overlooking the East River, this stylish hotel is 4 miles from both the Brooklyn Bridge and the Empire State Building. Bedford Avenue subway station is a 7-minute walk away. Chic rooms offer Wi-Fi and TVs. Upgraded rooms add balconies. Suites feature separate living areas; some have terraces, kitchenettes and minibars. Room service is available. There's a seasonal outdoor pool with a poolside bar. Other amenities include a 24-hour gym and a Balinese-inspired restaurant, as well as a rooftop bar with a terrace and river views.

name: Regina’s New York Bed and Breakfast
Umbrella Hotel Brooklyn
description: Set in an area with commercial properties and residential streets, this low-key hotel is 2 minutes' walk from Fort Hamilton Parkway subway station and 7 miles from the Statue of Liberty National Monument. The compact, unpretentious rooms come with flat-screen TVs. Some rooms have coffeemakers. There's a straightforward dining room. Limited parking is also available.

name: Insignia Hotel Brooklyn, an Ascend Collection Hotel
description: Set among restaurants and bars in Chinatown, this contemporary hotel is a 3-minute walk from a subway station, 6 miles from the Brooklyn Museum and 7 miles from One World Trade Center in Lower Manhattan. The understated rooms with black-and-white artwork provide free Wi-Fi, smart TVs and Keurig coffeemakers. Breakfast is complimentary. There's also a convenience store. Parking is available, and pets are welcome, both for a fee.

name: Hotel BPM Brooklyn
description: Set in Sunset Park neighborhood, this trendy, music-themed hotel is 2 miles from Prospect Park and 3.3 miles from Manhattan. The bright, contemporary rooms have hardwood floors, leather headboards, rainfall showers and 24-hour room service, plus free Wi-Fi, web-connected HDTVs, minibars and coffeemakers. Breakfast is available (fee) and there's a bar with weekend DJ parties.

name: Holiday Inn Express Nyc Brooklyn - Sunset Park by IHG
description: Set 2 minutes away by foot from the nearest subway station, this straightforward hotel is 3 miles from Brooklyn Botanic Garden and 5 miles from Brooklyn Bridge Park. Casual, simply furnished rooms are equipped with desks, Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as microwaves, minifridges and coffeemakers. A breakfast buffet is served in an informal dining area.

name: Park Slope Bed and Breakfast
description: Cozy brownstone townhouse offering a quaint 1-bedroom suite with a fireplace, plus a yoga studio.

description: Warmly decorated rooms in a quaint B&B offering a communal kitchen & a living room.

name: Hotel RL Brooklyn
description: Fashionable property offering modern rooms with locally inspired art & Wi-Fi.

description: Laid-back rooms in an informal hotel offering complimentary breakfast, parking & Wi-Fi.

King Hotel Brooklyn Sunset Park

description: Cozy rooms in a straightforward hotel offering complimentary breakfast, plus a fitness center.

description: Unpretentious budget hotel offering a complimentary hot breakfast buffet & Wi-Fi.

Knights Inn Brooklyn Sunset Park
description: Casual rooms featuring microwaves in an unpretentious hotel a short walk from a subway station.

Arlington Place

name: Atlantic Motor Inn

name: Serenity at Home Guest House Bed and Breakfast
description: Elegant B&B offering refined rooms with wood floors, plus a light bagel breakfast & free WiFi.

description: Snug bed-and-breakfast offering 1 warmly decorated room, a sitting room & a kitchen, plus a garden.

description: Informal budget hotel offering relaxed rooms, plus complimentary breakfast & parking.

description: Refined lodging in an 1880s townhouse with continental breakfast & weekly live jazz sessions.

description: Hip rooms, some with city views, in a casual hotel offering complimentary Wi-Fi & breakfast.

Holiday Inn Express Building 107

description: Down-to-earth rooms & a 24-hour fitness room, plus complimentary breakfast & Wi-Fi.

description: Basic rooms, some with whirlpool tubs, in a modest budget hotel offering free continental breakfast.

The Vue Inn Brooklyn
description: Casual rooms in a straightforward hotel featuring complimentary Wi-Fi & parking.

name: East New York Inn
description: Budget accommodations offering free continental breakfast, in-room WiFi & limited on-site parking.

name: Hotel Bliss - Brooklyn
description: Low-key lodging features simple rooms with flat-screen TVs and desks, plus free parking.

name: Days Inn by Wyndham Brooklyn Crown Heights
description: On a street lined with shops, this straightforward budget hotel is 5 miles from Prospect Park, 8 miles from the Brooklyn Bridge and a 9-minute walk from Broadway Junction subway station. Compact, down-to-earth rooms feature flat-screen TVs, in addition to minifridges and complimentary Wi-Fi. Parking is free, as is breakfast served in a simple dining room. There's also a fitness room.

name: Imperial Hotel
description: Unassuming option near public transportation offers basic rooms, some with jetted tubs.

name: Super 8 by Wyndham Brooklyn Pennsylvania Ave
Galaxy Motel Brooklyn
description: This budget Brooklyn motel with a low-key, concrete exterior is a minute's walk from the closest bus stop and 6.4 miles from John F. Kennedy International Airport. Traditionally furnished, air-conditioned single or double rooms offer free WiFi, flat-screen TVs and work desks, as well as private bathrooms with showers and tubs. Rooms with minifridges and microwaves are also available. Perks include free parking, a 24-hour front desk and elevator service. Jamaican, Chinese and Indian restaurants are among the dining options within 2 blocks of the motel.

name: Oasis Motel
description: This bare-bones motel with exterior corridors is 6.1 miles from John F. Kennedy International Airport, 8 miles from Coney Island, and 11.5 miles from One World Trade Center in Manhattan. Straightforward, air-conditioned rooms come with en suite bathrooms, plus coffeemakers, cable TV and free Wi-Fi. Parking is complimentary, and there are vending machines.

name: Riviera Motor Inn
description: A 2-minute walk from Cleveland St subway, this straightforward hotel is 6 miles from Brooklyn Botanic Garden and 9 miles from the zoo and museums in Flushing Meadows-Corona Park. The no-nonsense rooms with en suite bathrooms have complimentary Wi-Fi and cable TV, as well as microwaves and minifridges. Upgraded rooms add whirlpool tubs. Amenities include free parking.

name: Linden Motor Inn
description: Budget motor inn, close to public transportation, features simple, unassuming rooms.

name: Delz Bed & Breakfast
description: Casual B&B offering down-to-earth quarters, a cozy lounge & a shared kitchen, as well as free Wi-Fi.

name: Avenue Plaza Hotel
description: Set in Borough Park neighborhood, this unassuming hotel in a redbrick building is 4 blocks from a subway station, 16 miles from LaGuardia airport and 6 miles from Brooklyn Bridge. Traditional rooms have balconies, coffeemakers and Wi-Fi. Upgraded rooms add kitchenettes. A breakfast buffet is served. Parking is available. There's also meeting space and a guest laundry service.

name: Days Inn by Wyndham Brooklyn Marine Park
description: Set within 7 minutes' walk of eateries, this modest budget hotel is 4 minutes' walk from a bus stop and 6 miles from Coney Island, which features Luna Park amusement park and a beach. The unpretentious rooms come with complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, as well as tea and coffeemaking facilities. Free hot breakfast is served in a straightforward dining room.

name: Ramada By Wyndham Brooklyn Near Flatbush
Honey's Bed & Breakfast
description: Quaint B&B offering rooms with private bathrooms, 2 porches & free Wi-Fi in a Victorian house.

name: Best Western Gregory Hotel
description: Set in the residential Bay Ridge neighborhood, this unpretentious hotel is a 3-minute walk from subways at 86 Street Station and 5 miles from the Alice Austen House museum. Featuring carpeted floors and dark wood furnishings, the relaxed rooms and suites offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemakers. Some have separate living areas, microwaves, minifridges and/or pull-out sofas. Breakfast is complimentary. There's also a cocktail lounge and meeting space.

name: Harbor Motor Inn
description: Family-operated budget hotel that offers basic rooms, as well as free Wi-Fi & parking.

name: Harbor House Bed & Breakfast
description: Overlooking New York Harbor, this homey B&B is adjacent to the Alice Austin House museum. The Staten Island Ferry is 2.2 miles away. Individually decorated rooms (some with shared baths) offer TVs and free WiFi. Accommodations range from cozy rooms with bunk beds to suites with separate sitting areas. There's 1 suite with a kitchenette. Amenities include a basic continental breakfast and free street parking.

name: Best Western Brooklyn-Coney Island Inn
description: Set in a brick building, this low-key hotel is a 7-minute walk from Bay 50th Street subway station. It’s also 1 mile from both the New York Aquarium and Coney Island Beach. The warm, down-to-earth rooms provide complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minifridges, and tea and coffeemakers. Breakfast is included. There’s also a 24-hour gym and a business center.

name: Sleep Inn Coney Island
description: A 6-minute walk from Bay 50 St subway station, this unfussy hotel is a mile both from the New York Aquarium and from rides and a boardwalk at Coney Island Beach. The casual rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, plus tea and coffeemaking equipment. A breakfast buffet and limited parking are complimentary. There's also a business center and a lobby sitting area.

name: Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites New York Staten Island
description: Set 11 miles from St. George Ferry Terminal, offering access to Manhattan, this down-to-earth hotel is 5 miles from The Jacques Marchais Museum of Tibetan Art and 8 miles from the Staten Island Zoo. Relaxed, colorful rooms, some with whirlpool tubs, feature free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. Suites add separate living rooms. Complimentary amenities include parking, a breakfast buffet and a ferry terminal shuttle. There's also a casual restaurant/bar, a convenience store and a gym. Coin-operated laundry facilities are available.

name: Hylan Inn
description: This basic, no-frills motel, set in Staten Island, lies 2.6 miles from Verrazano-Narrows Bridge, 3.6 miles  from Staten Island Zoo and 8.8 miles from Coney Island. The straightforward, Wi-Fi-free rooms with wood furnishings come with cable TV, newspapers and room service. On-site amenities include a reception, business centers and complimentary parking.

name: Hilton Garden Inn New York/Staten Island
description: Set within the preserved woodland of Staten Island's Industrial Park, this contemporary hotel is an 8-minute drive from Interstate 278. Rooms feature flat-screen TVs, microwaves, minifridges and free WiFi, as well as chic decor and custom-designed beds. In addition to an upscale Italian restaurant and cabaret with select evening performances, there's a modern lounge with live entertainment and a 24/7 pantry. There's also a fitness center. Other perks include a 10,000 sq ft ballroom overlooking landscaped gardens and a free Newark Liberty International Airport shuttle.

name: Comfort Inn
description: Off NY-440, this casual hotel is 12 miles from the Hudson River Waterfront Walkway, 4 miles from Historic Richmond Town and 3 miles from Willowbrook Park. Decorated in warm and neutral tones, the unfussy rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers, as well as en suite bathrooms. Complimentary perks include breakfast and parking. There's also an exercise room, meeting space and a business center.

name: Fort Pl B&B & Gallery
description: In a residential neighborhood, this quaint, Victorian-style B&B is 13 minutes' walk from the St. George–Manhattan ferry terminal. It's 5 miles from the Verrazano–Narrows Bridge and 15 miles from the Statue of Liberty. The 3 homey rooms, each with a private floor, offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and en suite bathrooms, plus sitting areas, and tea and coffeemakers; 2 have fireplaces. The top-floor room has a skylight, a tub and bridge views, while another has a kitchen. Continental breakfast is served in-room. Parking is complimentary. There's a sunroom and a casual living area.

name: Brooklyn Way Hotel
description: Unfussy rooms in a relaxed property offering breakfast & Wi-Fi, plus a sauna & a gym.

name: Adria Hotel & Conference Center
description: This budget hotel with an old-school rockwall facade on its ground floor sits a block from the Cross Island Parkway on a commercial boulevard in a residential Queens neighborhood. The closest bus stop is a minute's walk from the hotel, and LaGuardia Airport is 8.6 miles away. Warm, modern rooms have free WiFi, plus coffeemakers, minifridges and flat-screen TVs. Studios add pull-out sofas. Room service is available (limited hours). Freebies include continental breakfast, parking, and all-day tea and coffee in the lobby. An on-site restaurant with a Spanish-influenced menu serves 3 meals a day. There's also a ballroom and 5 meeting rooms.

name: TWA Hotel
description: Set in the iconic former TWA flight center designed by architect Eero Saarinen, this chic airport hotel on the grounds of John F. Kennedy International Airport is 6 miles from the King Manor Museum and 12 miles from Rockaway Beach. Featuring soundproofed floor-to-ceiling windows, the stylish, retro rooms come with complimentary Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, plus minifridges, safes and fully stocked cocktail bars. Some have airport views. There's a sleek 1960s-inspired bar, a food hall with grab-and-go options, and a celebrity chef-helmed restaurant/cafe. Amenities include a 10,000-sq-ft gym, meeting space, and an outdoor pool with runway views.

name: Days Inn & Suites by Wyndham Jamaica JFK Airport
description: A 9-minute walk from the nearest subway station, this informal hotel is 3 miles from John F. Kennedy International Airport and 5 miles from Flushing Meadows Corona Park. Relaxed rooms come with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as microwaves, minifridges, and tea and coffeemakers. Suites add sofabeds. Kids age 17 and under stay at no extra cost when accompanied by an adult. Freebies include continental breakfast, parking and a 24/7 airport shuttle. Other amenities consist of a casual bar and an exercise room.

name: Paramount Inn
description: Set along Highway 25, this unassuming hotel is 2 miles from Queens County Farm Museum and 3 miles from Belmont Park racecourse. The relaxed rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Some provide whirlpool tubs. Complimentary amenities include parking, and breakfast served in a relaxed dining room that has marble floors.

name: Ramada by Wyndham Staten Island
description: Off Interstate 278, this straightforward hotel is 2 miles from the Greenbelt Nature Center and 3 miles from the Staten Island Zoo. Down-to-earth rooms feature free Wi-Fi, minifridges and coffeemakers, plus flat-screen TVs. Suites add in-room whirlpool tubs. Continental breakfast and parking are complimentary. Other amenities include an exercise room and a business center.

name: Days Inn by Wyndham Staten Island
Hampton Inn & Suites Staten Island
description: This straightforward hotel off the Staten Island Expressway is 6 miles from Historic Richmond Town and 7 miles from the Staten Island Ferry, offering service to Lower Manhattan. The classic rooms and suites feature custom-designed beds, flat-screen TVs and free Wi-Fi, plus both full and lap desks (for working on the bed). They also have microwaves, minifridges and coffeemakers. Suites add pull-out sofas. Freebies include hot breakfast (with a grab-&-go option available on weekdays). There's also a gym and a restaurant, plus a 24/7 business center and meeting space.

name: Victorian Bed And Breakfast Of Staten Island
description: This 1846 B&B featuring original Victorian decor, including chandeliers and fireplaces with marble mantels, is 1.5 miles west of the Snug Harbor Cultural Center & Botanical Garden and 4 miles from the Staten Island Ferry. Traditional rooms with shared bathrooms are individually decorated with antiques. There's 1 room with a kitchen and another with an attached screened porch. Amenities include a full homemade breakfast and afternoon tea.

name: Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, Staten Island
